argv_note: stone-llama default llama-backend argv, from internal/serve/llama_backend.go Spawn() and confirmed on the live child /proc cmdline (pid 644766): llama-server --host 127.0.0.1 --port <internal> --api-key-file <runtime>/upstream_key -m <gguf>. ollama.note: ollama's daemon kept a resident stone daemon's GGUF on the card during this window (run.sh STONE_START=0 path does not stop it) — its timings are confounded; the clean warm numbers are TTFT 0.196 s / decode 6.0 tok/s / peak 2922 MiB. Round 1's clean ollama numbers (55.8 tok/s, 2568 MiB, ctx 8192) were measured with stone fully unloaded and remain the honest baseline.

same_quant_stone_vs_ollama.verdict: On identical Q4_K_M weights, stone-llama's llama.cpp path decodes ~9x faster than ollama's llama.cpp path (53.5 vs 6.0 tok/s) and uses less VRAM (2761 vs 2922 MiB), because ollama runs -np 1 with --context-shift/--keep and a chatml template while stone runs llama-server's defaults (no -np, no ctx cap, auto flash-attn). The gap is wrapper/flag set, not the quant.

flash_attn_ab.base: stone-llama default argv (LLAMA_ARG_FLASH_ATTN unset -> llama-server default 'auto')
flash_attn_ab.verdict: Flash attention gives a measurable +9% decode and -8% wall on this 3B Q4_K_M pair; VRAM difference is noise (14 MiB). Turning -fa off does not change the verdict (stone still ~9x ollama).

nommap_ab.verdict: No measurable difference on this model/size (decode identical, wall within 0.1%, VRAM identical). --no-mmap is not worth exercising further; mmap is fine.

round1_comparison.note: Round 1's ollama number (55.8 tok/s) was measured with stone fully unloaded and ollama warm; round 2's stone number (53.5 tok/s) is within ~4% of it. On identical weights stone-llama matches ollama's warm decode while offering 4x the context (32768 vs 8192) at +193 MiB VRAM. The round-1 'stone loses warm decode' verdict was an artifact of comparing EXL3 4.0bpw (3.5 bpw) against Q4_K_M, not of the wrapper.

not_exercised: stone-llama's own default argv has no -ngl flag (llama-server defaults to 'auto' GPU offload); measuring -ngl all vs auto was not requested and the model already offloads fully (2752 MiB resident).
